fields.why: The VISION model enters age and calendar day as natural cubic splines (table note), a nonlinear transformation that A records as ancillary; the brief names only 'splines drawn as trends', so B's omission of covariate splines is also defensible.

VE is estimated for three vaccination-status levels (no updated dose as referent, 7–59 days, 60–119 days) and the two intervals are compared for waning; with three or more groups the brief says use group, and A's own 'across' lists interval since updated dose.

brief_issues: Spline terms for adjustment covariates inside a model are not covered (same gap as in pilot 1); a rule such as 'covariate splines are part of the model specification, not a transformation procedure' (or the reverse) would decide it.
